title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 10A: The home
subtitle: The home, in / on and present continuous verbs from 10A

words.def: the room where you sleep
words.sent: There’s a desk and a bed in my ___.

words.def: the room with a shower or a bath
words.sent: The shower is in the ___.

words.def: the room where you cook
words.sent: Put the cake in the ___, next to the cooker.

words.def: the room with the sofa and the TV
words.sent: We’re watching the match on TV in the ___.

words.def: the room with a big table where you eat meals
words.sent: We eat dinner at the big table in the ___.

words.def: the place outside your house with grass and flowers
words.sent: The children are playing outside in the ___.

words.def: you open it to go into a room
words.sent: Please close the ___ when you go out.

words.def: glass in a wall; you look out of it
words.sent: It’s hot. Can you open the ___?

words.def: the part of a room you walk on
words.sent: The books are on the ___, not on the table.

words.def: the side of a room; you put pictures on it
words.sent: There are pictures on the ___.

words.def: a table where you work or study
words.sent: There’s a computer on the ___ in my bedroom.

words.def: a painting or photo you put on a wall
words.sent: There’s a beautiful ___ of the sea on the wall.

words.def: a game of football or tennis between two teams
words.sent: We’re watching the football ___ on TV.

words.def: looking at something now (a film, TV, a match)
words.sent: Be quiet! We’re ___ the match.

words.def: learning now, for example for an exam
words.sent: I can’t go out. I’m ___ for my exam.

words.def: making food hot now
words.sent: I’m ___ your dinner — it’s ready in ten minutes.

words.def: on a chair now, not standing
words.sent: I’m ___ in the car outside the house.

words.def: speaking now
words.sent: Steve’s ___ too much — I can’t hear the TV!

words.def: not in the building
words.sent: I’m in the car ___ the house. Come out!

words.def: on the side of a room
words.sent: There’s a clock ___ in the kitchen.
